before.known: can you tell me about those people?
before.target: 你能告诉我关于那些人吗？

after.known: can you tell me about those people?
after.target: 你能告诉我关于那些人的事吗？
after.roman: nǐ néng gàosu wǒ guānyú nàxiē rén de shì ma?

add.why: #219: 关于 needs a noun after it: 关于那些人 → 关于那些人的事 ('the matters about those people')

after.known: are you ready?
after.roman: nǐ zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma?

add.why: #219: 'are you ready?' needs 了 (as S0080L02U03, S0095L01U02, S0252L01U02 already have)

after.known: are we ready?
after.roman: wǒmen zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma?

add.why: #219: same: 'are we ready?' needs 了

before.known: I want to learn this new thing quickly

after.known: I want to learn this new thing quickly
after.roman: wǒ xiǎng jǐnkuài xué zhè xīn dōngxi

add.why: #219: 快学 is not idiomatic; 'quickly' is taught as 尽快 (S0020L02)

before.known: she wants it to be perfect

after.known: she wants it to be perfect
after.roman: tā xiǎng ràng tā wánměi

add.why: #219: 她想那完美 'she wants that perfect' is ungrammatical; 想让它完美 = wants it to be perfect

after.known: where did she go?
after.roman: tā qù nǎlǐ le?

add.why: #219: past question 'where did she go?' needs 了, as U15 has

before.known: what do you think about that

after.known: what do you think about that
after.roman: nàge nǐ juéde zěnmeyàng

add.why: #219: object 那个 cannot follow 怎么样; it is fronted as the topic

before.known: I need to be ready by tomorrow

after.known: I need to be ready by tomorrow
after.target: 我需要在明天之前准备好
after.roman: wǒ xūyào zài míngtiān zhīqián zhǔnbèi hǎo

add.why: #219: 在明天 says 'tomorrow', not 'by tomorrow'; 'by' = 之前 (taught S0249)

before.known: I don't have the faintest idea what to do
before.target: 我一点头绪都没有该做什么

after.known: I don't have the faintest idea what to do
after.target: 该做什么，我一点头绪都没有
after.roman: gāi zuò shénme, wǒ yìdiǎn tóuxù dōu méiyǒu

add.why: #219: 'what to do' cannot trail after 都没有; it comes first

before.known: he's reading the same book as me

after.known: he's reading the same book as me
after.roman: tā hé wǒ zài dú tóng yì běn shū

add.why: #219: 在读和我同一本书 is ungrammatical; 和我 goes before the verb

after.known: spend time with you
after.roman: huā shíjiān hé nǐ zài yìqǐ

add.why: #219: 和你花时间 is an English calque; Chinese shape is 花时间和…在一起 (as the seed itself)

before.known: I want to spend time with you

after.known: I want to spend time with you
after.target: 我想花时间和你在一起
after.roman: wǒ xiǎng huā shíjiān hé nǐ zài yìqǐ

add.why: #219: same calque

before.known: do you want to spend time with them?

after.known: do you want to spend time with them?
after.target: 你想花时间和他们在一起吗
after.roman: nǐ xiǎng huā shíjiān hé tāmen zài yìqǐ ma

add.why: #219: same calque

after.known: come with me
after.roman: gēn wǒ yìqǐ zǒu

add.why: #219: 跟…一起 needs a person in it; 跟一起走 is not Chinese

before.known: do you know who was wearing green?

after.known: do you know who was wearing green?
after.roman: nǐ zhīdào shéi chuān le lǜsè ma?

add.why: #219: 谁在穿 = who is putting on; 'was wearing' is 穿了 here (as S0393L03U06 谁穿了绿色衬衫; 着 untaught)

before.target: 那件蓝色的衣服很好看

after.known: that blue dress is pretty
after.target: 那件蓝色的连衣裙很好看
after.roman: nà jiàn lánsè de liányīqún hěn hǎokàn

add.why: #219: 'dress' is taught as 连衣裙 (S0394L02); 衣服 = clothes

before.known: I will go no matter what

after.known: I will go no matter what happens
after.target: 不管发生什么我都会去
after.roman: bùguǎn fāshēng shénme wǒ dōu huì qù

add.why: #219: 不管什么 needs a verb: 不管发生什么, as U04/U05

after.known: she came no matter what happened
after.target: 不管发生什么她都来了
after.roman: bùguǎn fāshēng shénme tā dōu lái le

add.why: #219: same

before.known: nobody wants that to happen to them
before.target: 没有人想这发生在身上

after.known: nobody wants that to happen to them
after.target: 没有人想这发生在自己身上
after.roman: méiyǒu rén xiǎng zhè fāshēng zài zìjǐ shēnshang

add.why: #219: 发生在身上 needs whose body: 在自己身上 (自己 taught S0516)

after.known: I'll call you back later
after.roman: wǒ wǎndiǎn gěi nǐ huí diànhuà

add.why: #219: 以后 = 'some time in the future'; 'later (today)' is 晚点 (taught, S0239L01U11)

before.known: I didn't think that was crazy

after.known: I didn't think that was crazy
after.roman: wǒ bù juéde nà shì fēngkuáng de

add.why: #219: 以为 = 'wrongly believed'; plain 'think' is 觉得 (taught)

before.known: I don't think it's a bad thing

after.known: I don't think it's a bad thing
after.roman: wǒ bù juéde nà shì huàishì

add.why: #219: same 以为 fault

before.known: she thinks it's a bad thing

after.known: she thinks it's a bad thing
after.roman: tā juéde nà shì huàishì

add.why: #219: same 以为 fault (present 'thinks'), same basket

before.known: I think that's a bad idea

after.known: I think that's a bad idea
after.roman: wǒ juéde nà shì gè huài zhǔyi

add.why: #219: same 以为 fault

before.known: I didn't think it was this hard

after.known: I didn't think it was this hard
after.roman: wǒ méi xiǎngdào zhème nán

add.why: #219: 没以为 is ungrammatical; 'didn't think it was' = 没想到 (taught S0239L01U09)

after.known: nobody thinks it's ugly
after.roman: méiyǒu rén juéde nà hěn chǒu

add.why: #219: same 以为 fault

after.known: I think that's ugly
after.roman: wǒ juéde nà hěn chǒu

add.why: #219: same 以为 fault

before.target: 我住的地方离工作很近

after.known: I live close to work
after.target: 我住的地方离工作的地方很近
after.roman: wǒ zhù de dìfang lí gōngzuò de dìfang hěn jìn

add.why: #219: 离 needs a place: 工作的地方, as S0614L03U03

before.known: I need to know if you're all ready
before.target: 我需要知道你们准备好了吗

after.known: I need to know if you're all ready
after.target: 我需要知道你们准备好了没有
after.roman: wǒ xūyào zhīdào nǐmen zhǔnbèi hǎo le méiyǒu

add.why: #219: 吗 cannot end an embedded question; …了没有

before.known: I just wanted to tell you something
before.target: 我刚才想告诉你一件事

after.known: I wanted to tell you something a moment ago
after.target: 我刚才想告诉你一件事

add.why: #219: English made to say what the Chinese says (刚才 = a moment ago); the old English is S0357L01U02 = 我只是想… (ZUT)

after.known: a very good heart

add.why: #219: English made to say what the Chinese says; 'a kind heart' is S0478L03 = 善良的心 (ZUT)

before.known: you have a very kind heart

after.known: you have a very good heart

add.why: #219: same

after.known: area

add.why: #219: bare 'field' = 场地 (S0353L01); this LEGO's own gloss is 'area' (ZUT)

after.known: come on their own

add.why: #219: B01 has the same English 'on their own' over different Chinese (自己 vs 自己来)

after.known: I want to keep quiet

add.why: #219: English made to say what the Chinese says: 安静 = quiet, not calm

before.known: I want to take her somewhere

after.known: I want to take her to that place

add.why: #219: English made to say what the Chinese says: 那个地方 = that place, not somewhere

before.known: I often want to take the children somewhere
before.target: 我经常想带孩子们去那个地方

after.known: I often want to take the children to that place
after.target: 我经常想带孩子们去那个地方

add.why: #219: same

after.known: nobody got the last one

add.why: #219: English made to say what the Chinese says: no 'seat' in it

before.known: I knew this would happen sooner or later

after.known: I knew all along this would happen

add.why: #219: English made to say what the Chinese says: 早知道 = knew all along, not 'sooner or later'
#219: 唯一这个 is ungrammatical (唯一 needs 的 + noun); no taught fix keeps the LEGO

before.known: can you tell me about this new thing?
before.target: 你能告诉我关于这新东西吗？

add.why: #219: 告诉我关于这新东西 is ungrammatical; a fix (…的事) reads clumsily; 9 USE remain

before.known: I'm not very good at this

add.why: #219: 我这个不太好 is not Chinese for 'not very good at this'; needs untaught 擅长

before.known: I don't know what I'm trying to say

add.why: #219: 我不知道我想说的 is ungrammatical (needs 什么), and 什么 would break the LEGO 我想说的

before.known: I'm not sure what I'm trying to say

add.why: #219: same as U03
#219: 找钱 is the fixed phrase 'give change'; teaches the wrong sense

before.known: let me think about this for a little while

add.why: #219: 让我想一会儿这个: object cannot follow the duration; no fix keeps the English

before.known: unfortunately I have to go to a meeting

add.why: #219: 去会议 is not Chinese (开会/参加会议 untaught here)

before.known: I'm willing to come to the meeting

add.why: #219: 来会议: same

before.known: we can go to the meeting

add.why: #219: 去会议: same
#219: 她会说得好 reads 'she will speak well' (会 + manner complement clash)
#219: same

before.known: if he knows the answer to this

add.why: #219: 答案这个 is ungrammatical
#219: 更好多了 stacks 更 and 多了; 'much better' (好多了) would drop the LEGO 更好

before.known: she's much better at speaking Chinese than I am
before.target: 她说中文比我更好多了

add.why: #219: same 更好多了 fault
#219: 这个显得很好 is odd Chinese and the English is stilted
#219: 很伤 is not Chinese for 'very hurt'
#219: 将要 + 试试 is an ungrammatical mix
#219: 待着安静 is not Chinese; also a bare imperative USE
#219: 去了哪儿 is the question 'where did … go', not 'went somewhere'

before.known: I have four people in my family

add.why: #219: 我家庭有四人 is not Chinese (我家有四口人 drops the LEGO 四人)
#219: 赢得 needs an object; unfinished sentence
#219: 多大年纪 is the respectful 'how old' for older people, wrong for a child
#219: 一种方法在这里: wrong word order
#219: 我觉得同样 is not Chinese

before.known: he was tired yet still went

add.why: #219: 而还是 is ungrammatical
#219: 这的一部分 is ungrammatical
#219: same 这的 fault
#219: 人数量 is not Chinese

before.known: he forgot even though I told him once
before.target: 他忘了即使我告诉过他一次

add.why: #219: 即使 'even if' cannot follow the main clause like this

before.known: she can't see over the wall

add.why: #219: 看不过墙 is not Chinese
